method_note: All 32 authenticated team sections were reviewed. The article's projected unit grade is converted to a deliberately small QB/RB environment signal; the supporting text preserves the published 2025 pass/run-blocking ranks where supplied. Near-average C+ units are visible but score zero.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Arizona's rebuilt 2026 offensive line B-, improved on the left side but still thin and unsettled at right tackle.
signals.mechanism: An upgraded interior helps, while right-tackle and depth risk keep protection and run efficiency from being a clear strength.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Atlanta's 2026 line C+, with four credible starters but a major right-tackle question despite Bill Callahan's arrival.
signals.mechanism: Strong coaching and interior play can support the run, while one weak edge can still disrupt protection and outside concepts.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Baltimore's revamped 2026 line C- after losing center Tyler Linderbaum and changing three interior spots.
signals.mechanism: Interior turnover and a center downgrade can weaken both pocket stability and the run game until the new group gels.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Buffalo's mostly intact 2026 line A after top-four pass- and run-blocking results in 2025.
signals.mechanism: Continuity and high-end blocking support both Josh Allen's pocket and the backfield's efficiency, with left guard the main uncertainty.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Carolina's deep, balanced 2026 line B+ after a top-four run-blocking finish in 2025.
signals.mechanism: Solid starters and credible tackle depth should create running room and reduce the burden on the quarterback.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Chicago's deep 2026 line A- after top-five pass- and run-blocking results and further draft investment.
signals.mechanism: Strong protection and run blocking increase the efficiency floor for Caleb Williams and the backfield.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Cincinnati's young, intact 2026 line C after bottom-seven pass- and run-blocking results in 2025.
signals.mechanism: Late-season growth offers hope, but continued tackle and youth-related inconsistency can pressure the quarterback and limit rushing efficiency.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Cleveland's overhauled 2026 line D after it finished last in pass blocking and near the bottom in run blocking in 2025.
signals.mechanism: Five-man turnover may eventually help, but weak recent performance and cohesion risk materially lower early-season confidence.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Dallas' 2026 line C: strong interior run blocking but continued problems at both tackle spots.
signals.mechanism: The split profile supports the rushing lane efficiency while leaving the passing game exposed to edge pressure.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Denver's intact 2026 line A+, calling it arguably the league's best after elite protection in 2025.
signals.mechanism: Five returning starters and strong depth raise both pocket stability and rushing efficiency.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Detroit's diminished 2026 line C, with run blocking still stronger than protection.
signals.mechanism: A weaker interior and reliance on a rookie lower Jared Goff's protection floor, while the run game can remain useful if the unit stays healthy.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Green Bay's 2026 line D and identifies the interior as one of the league's weakest groups.
signals.mechanism: Interior pressure and limited rushing lanes can hurt Jordan Love's efficiency and Josh Jacobs' aging rushing profile.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Houston's still-changing 2026 line C after below-average protection and run blocking in 2025.
signals.mechanism: A rookie center, young tackle, and injury-prone veterans create a wide outcome range and continued pressure risk for C.J. Stroud.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Indianapolis' mostly intact 2026 line A after top-four pass- and run-blocking results in 2025.
signals.mechanism: High-end blocking supports Jonathan Taylor and the passing game, with a young new right tackle the primary risk.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Jacksonville's returning 2026 line C after solid but uneven 2025 results and persistent sack problems.
signals.mechanism: Continuity helps timing, but tackle pressure keeps the offense from receiving a positive line adjustment.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Kansas City's 2026 line B-, with credible blocking but several changed starters and health questions.
signals.mechanism: The unit is slightly above average on paper but not strong enough to erase early uncertainty around the rebuilt offense.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Las Vegas' 2026 line C after last-place sack and adjusted-line-yard results, with the new staff expected to improve the scheme.
signals.mechanism: Coaching can help, but the prior baseline and personnel questions still create pressure and rushing-efficiency risk.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades the healthier, reinforced Chargers line A and sees top-10 potential under the new staff.
signals.mechanism: Improved personnel, coaching, and fullback support materially strengthen the environment for Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades the Rams' 2026 line A- after it led the league in run blocking and adjusted line yards in 2025.
signals.mechanism: Elite run blocking supports Kyren Williams, though thin depth and a possible suspension create some fragility.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Miami's largely unchanged 2026 line D after bottom-six pass- and run-blocking results in 2025.
signals.mechanism: A weak line can undermine the new run-first plan and lower both quarterback efficiency and backfield consistency.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Minnesota's 2026 line C, with capable tackles but a questionable interior and a new line coach.
signals.mechanism: Edge protection may hold up, while interior weakness creates more concern for the run game and quarterback durability.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades New England's talented 2026 line B+, with high upside if its young tackles and injury-prone veterans stay available.
signals.mechanism: Improved protection and depth support Drake Maye and the run game, but health and position changes still create variance.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades New Orleans' 2026 line C, with a decent left side but weak run blocking and unresolved right-side questions.
signals.mechanism: Average protection may be serviceable, but limited rushing lanes reduce confidence in the backfield exceeding its role-based value.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades the improved Giants line C+, with new guard talent and experienced depth but no top-tier projection.
signals.mechanism: The group should be serviceable enough to help Jaxson Dart and the run game, but it is not a distinct fantasy advantage.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades the Jets' 2026 line C- after guard losses and continued center and cohesion questions.
signals.mechanism: Promising young tackles cannot fully offset interior weakness, lowering confidence in both protection and run efficiency.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Philadelphia's 2026 line B+, still strong and younger despite a coaching change and some recent injuries.
signals.mechanism: Above-average line play supports the run-led offense, though the group is no longer the automatic league-best unit of prior seasons.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Pittsburgh's young, improving 2026 line B after a strong pass-blocking season and further first-round investment.
signals.mechanism: An upward-trending unit improves the floor for the quarterback and backfield, with health the main unresolved issue.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades San Francisco's 2026 line B, with strong tackle play and run blocking but one weak interior spot and age-related fragility.
signals.mechanism: The unit remains a net positive when healthy, though Trent Williams' availability materially affects the outlook.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Seattle's 2026 line C and expects regression after losing the coaches who helped mask weak guard play.
signals.mechanism: A first-time play caller and weaker line instruction increase pressure and rushing-efficiency risk despite some young depth.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Tampa Bay's 2026 line C+, with strong tackles but interior and depth questions.
signals.mechanism: The unit is close to neutral: healthy starters can improve it, but the interior does not justify a positive fantasy adjustment yet.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Tennessee's 2026 offensive line D-, one of the league's worst units despite a new coach and several additions.
signals.mechanism: Weak depth and multiple underperforming starters can derail Cam Ward's development and prevent the new run scheme from creating consistent lanes.

signals.summary: FantasyGuru grades Washington's 2026 line C-, with two strong pieces but continued interior holes.
signals.mechanism: Inconsistent inside blocking raises durability and efficiency concerns for Jayden Daniels and the run game.
